newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady, limited downside seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady, limited downside seen.

text.p: August Brent futures were untraded at midday on Friday but were quoted around the London settlement, brokers said.
August Brent was quoted on SIMEX at $17.84/$18.00 per barrel, after London dropped 26 cents to settle at $17.96 on news that Germany planned to sell 400 million marks of oil this year.
NYMEX August crude was last traded on ACCESS at $19.20 per barrel, down two cents from New York.
Credit Lyonnais Rouse said in a daily briefing that the market remained bearish technically, but an oversold position would limit the downside Friday.
